description: This file defines classes for generating code snippets for HTTP requests in different programming languages (JavaScript, Python, C#, Java) using the Playwright library. It includes classes for each language implementing a common interface, with methods to generate request call code based on request data. It also provides a factory function to select the appropriate generator based on language.

classes.name: JSCodeGen
classes.description: Generates JavaScript code snippets for Playwright requests, with methods to pretty-print objects and generate request call strings.

classes.name: PythonCodeGen
classes.description: Generates Python code snippets for Playwright requests, with methods to pretty-print objects and generate request call strings.

classes.name: CSharpCodeGen
classes.description: Generates C# code snippets for Playwright requests, with methods to pretty-print objects and generate request call strings.

classes.name: JavaCodeGen
classes.description: Generates Java code snippets for Playwright requests, with methods to pretty-print objects and generate request call strings.

methods.name: generatePlaywrightRequestCall
methods.description: Creates a code string for making a Playwright request in the respective language, based on request data.

methods.name: getAPIRequestCodeGen
methods.description: Factory function that returns an instance of the appropriate code generator class based on the specified language.
